# truenas_app (Data Source)

Fetches the current state of a TrueNAS app by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application name.

### Read-Only

- `catalog_app` (String) Catalog app the app was installed from (e.g. "plex"); null for custom apps.
- `custom_app` (Boolean) True for custom (compose-based) apps.
- `human_version` (String)
- `id` (String) App name (used as Terraform ID).
- `state` (String) Current app state (RUNNING, STOPPED, DEPLOYING, ...).
- `train` (String) Catalog train: stable, community, enterprise.
- `upgrade_available` (Boolean)
- `version` (String) Installed app version.
